rationale: Current best already spends scarce float budget on recurrent tail Q/K, which points to attention projection quantization as the remaining bottleneck. This run extends the existing transpose-aware int8 path from `mlp.fc.weight` to non-float `attn.c_q.weight` and `attn.c_k.weight` so earlier and mid-layer Q/K use per-input-channel scaling instead of per-output scaling, aiming to reduce roundtrip distortion at effectively zero training-time or artifact-size cost.
title: Transpose-Aware QK Int8 On Recurrent Tail Best
